sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: For the simple hours in this unit, add -kor to the hour: hétkor, nyolckor.

This is the same -kor you just met hiding inside mikor (mi + kor). Once you can hear it as its own piece, the pattern generalises to any hour without any irregular forms to memorise: egykor, kettőkor, háromkor... it's -kor all the way up.
